topic: Otzi the Iceman — a 5,300-year-old murder mystery

beats.narration: In 1991, hikers found a body melting out of an Alpine glacier.
beats.image_prompt: high alpine glacier landscape, icy blue tones, misty peaks, cinematic documentary style, no people

beats.narration: Otzi lived about 5,300 years ago. His gear included a copper axe, a bow, and a quiver of arrows.
beats.image_prompt: ancient copper axe and wooden bow on stone, prehistoric tools, museum-style dramatic lighting, no people

beats.narration: A flint arrowhead was lodged in his shoulder. He had defensive wounds on his hands.
beats.image_prompt: close-up of a prehistoric flint arrowhead, sharp edges, dark moody lighting, forensic documentary style, no people

beats.narration: He likely died from the arrow wound — one of the oldest known forensic murder cases.
beats.image_prompt: snowy alpine pass at dusk, lonely and cold atmosphere, cinematic wide shot, no people
